description: The onboarding loop that prepares a heterogeneous C/C++ codebase for Frama-C verification and hands a validated onboarding package (build flags, scope map, durable <target>-acsl/ overlay, faithfulness baseline pin, one leaf smoke proof) up to frama-c-monitoring. It is itself an sl-monitoring-sl over its own prep work: a disjoint onboarding monitor squeezes the prober's flag-set, the architect's scope map and the scaffolder's baseline pin against the SHIPPED build profile and the real attack surface. Its distinctive lower bound is purpose-built ONBOARDING oracles (the parse oracle, frama-c -wp-detect, the strip-ACSL==HEAD faithfulness round-trip, one end-to-end smoke proof) — NOT WP verdicts (that layer is below). Dominant coherent-and-wrong: a config that parses cleanly but selects the WRONG feature set, a scope map that silently drops an attack-surface module, or a baseline pinned to the wrong commit/submodule.

disjointness.rationale: The onboarding monitor runs the prober/architect/scaffolder as sub-agents: the delegation boundary is the physical barrier — it sees only their returned artifacts (preprocess_context, scope_map, overlay), never a prep agent's rationale (prep_notes / architect_notes), and squeezes those artifacts against the shipped build + attack-surface gold, not a build that merely happens to parse. No single (U,L) certifies the package: the prober holds the shipped build docs + the parse/-wp-detect oracles; the architect holds the documented intent/risk study + the read-only source; the scaffolder holds the overlay convention + the faithfulness round-trip; each pair is genuinely distinct. Structure is the prober's, scope is the architect's, durability/faithfulness is the scaffolder's, and the monitor judges all three against the gold — never authoring what it grades.
disjointness.load_bearing_barrier: the prober selects flags from the SHIPPED build profile (shipped_build_docs + the parse/-wp-detect oracles), never flags that merely make a file parse; and the onboarding monitor differentially compares the prober/architect/scaffolder outputs against the shipped build + attack-surface gold while barriered from the prep agents' rationale. If the monitor read the prep rationale, or the prober chose parse-only flags, the package would converge on a config that parses but selects the wrong feature set — the coherent-and-wrong this loop exists to catch.

catchability.blind_spot: flags that parse cleanly but select the WRONG feature set / a different profile than the shipped one
catchability.via: differential comparison of preprocess_context against the shipped-profile attack-surface gold (not a build that merely parses)

catchability.blind_spot: a scope map that silently drops an attack-surface module / mis-ranks the queue
catchability.via: the monitor squeezes scope_map against the attack-surface gold + the risk study

catchability.blind_spot: a baseline pinned to the wrong commit/submodule; a dirty pin
catchability.via: the faithfulness round-trip (strip-ACSL == HEAD per repo + submodule) run differentially over the overlay

catchability.blind_spot: the monitor itself rubber-stamps or mis-gates an onboarding
catchability.via: the coordinator refuses to hand the package to frama-c-monitoring on the monitor's say-so until the aggregated onboarding oracles (parse/toolchain/faithfulness/smoke) are green

catchability.blind_spot: bad framing / rubber-stamped 'done' / hands off an un-gated package
catchability.via: the monitor will not have emitted PASS verdicts, so the Gate has no green to stand on

catchability.blind_spot: mis-reads Frama-C's behaviour / over-generalizes one experiment
catchability.via: the coordinator adjudicates probe verdicts at the Gate; the probe never fixes, only records
